Hi Sara — thanks for the quick note and the VAT cert. Quick checklist from Redwood procurement/finance to get PO 43021 live:

- Signed tax residency affidavit (we need a document confirming Einference is tax resident in Germany)
- Copy of VAT registration (you already attached; thank you)
- Bank wiring details on vendor letterhead (IBAN/SWIFT) and confirmation whether payments will be gross or under reverse-charge
- Invoice template that includes our PO number, your VAT number, invoice date, line-level descriptions, and the net/gross amounts; for EU invoices where reverse charge applies please include the phrase: "Reverse charge: Article 194(1) VAT Directive – VAT to be accounted for by the recipient"
- W-8/W-9 are not applicable for EU vendors (we only ask US vendors for W-9). For non-US vendors we require a local tax residency certificate or signed affidavit.

Preferred upload: vendor onboarding portal (https://vendor.redwood.ai/upload) — if you prefer email for the initial pass that's fine but final signed affidavit should be uploaded. If a document needs signature, we can send a DocuSign link.

If you can send the signed affidavit and bank letter by end of week we can aim to activate the PO within 5 business days after doc verification.

Best,

Hi Sara —

Thanks for sending the affidavit and bank letter. Finance reviewed and here are the formal invoice / submission rules to avoid rework:

1) Invoice header must include: your legal name, legal address, VAT number (DE123456789), and our PO number exactly as "PO-43021".
2) Line items should map to the PO lines; if you consolidate monthly, include a line-level reference to the original PO line and date range.
3) For EU VAT treatment: if the supply is treated under the reverse-charge mechanism (B2B services), invoice net amounts and include the following line near totals: "Reverse charge: Article 194(1) VAT Directive – no VAT charged by supplier; recipient to account for VAT." If you are charging VAT, include VAT line and ensure the VAT registration is valid for the invoice month.
4) Add wire details and a remittance contact on each invoice or upload to vendor portal.
5) Upload final signed affidavit to our vendor portal here: https://vendor.redwood.ai/upload and paste the portal confirmation ID in the invoice email thread. Our vendor portal will tag the record and trigger PO activation.

Checklist for PO activation (what Finance will verify):
- Signed tax residency affidavit (present)
- Valid VAT registration (present)
- Bank wiring letter on letterhead (present)
- Invoice template meets fields above (Finance will confirm on first invoice)

Once we verify the documents, Procurement will activate the PO and you will receive an automated confirmation email with the PO live date and payment terms (Net 30).

Thanks — feel free to upload and I will pick up the ticket for verification.

Monica Patel
Manager, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
